determinism: linear algebra deterministic; seed only used by assert self-check, no randomized POD

normalization_groups.definition: sqrt(trace(training displacement covariance)/3), shared by all three vector components

pod_energy_definition: Fraction of train-only case-to-case snapshot variance after per-channel standardization and subtraction of the training mean field; not physical strain/kinetic energy or fraction of uncentered raw signal.

input_information: Per-run global parameters only, normalized with train statistics; constant inputs dropped. Fixed geometry/reference coordinates are encoded by POD basis. No heldout response is a predictor input.
loss: Mean squared residual divided by the shared train-only field scales. XYZ use a common rotation-invariant vector scale when specified by normalization metadata; scalar fields retain their train scales. Equal node/time/channel weights; mean field uses train cases only. No response values replaced or clipped.
scope: Exploratory public benchmark; same fixed geometry, heldout GPU-model split cases previously exist in public FEM results; no blindtest or appliance generalization claim.
local_data_warning: Prediction NPZ/snapshots/mean field contain FEM-derived data; local evidence, excluded from public redistribution pending license handling.
